kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Apparently via Aramaic שׁוֹטָא (šōṭā) / ܫܱܘܛܳܐ (šawṭā, “whip”) from Old Georgian შოლტი (šolṭi, “whip”).
g: an astronomical measure of approximately 4.5 degrees
active participle of سَطَا (saṭā, “to rush, to assault”)
of a wide-stepped stance, as if ready to assail, reared up; precipitate; tall; long, elongate

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Morphologically from the root س ط و (s ṭ w).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: سَطَا • (saṭā) I (non-past يَسْطُو (yasṭū), verbal noun سَطْو (saṭw) or سَطْوَة (saṭwa))
g: to rush at, to spring upon to assault, to attack, to assail, to seize violently, to exact, to extract
to burglarize, to mug, to rob etc.
